summary: Onyx & Gold theme preset feature verified end-to-end. All 4 backend tests in test_iteration18_theme_preset.py PASS. Branding GET/PUT correctly persists `theme_preset`, /api/public/booking/manage/{code} returns business_theme_preset / business_primary_color / business_logo_url, /api/client/bookings includes business_theme_preset per appointment. UI smoke tests on Public Booking, Admin Dashboard, Settings → Branding, Manage Booking, and Calendar all confirm data-theme='onyx_gold' is applied with dark sidebar (rgb(15,15,15)), gold leaf SVG decor, Cinzel serif headings (rgb(245,239,224) text), and gold price/badge accents. Theme switching (onyx_gold ↔ default) works via the Settings preset cards and persists on subsequent GETs. 13/13 regression tests in test_settings_api.py and test_iteration17_availability_fix.py also pass — no regression introduced.

minor.issue: Endpoint REPLACES the entire branding sub-document with a $set on `branding` (server.py line 1135-1138). If a client PUTs a partial payload (e.g. only {theme_preset: 'default'}), all other branding fields like business_name, primary_color etc. are LOST. Frontend currently sends the full payload so this is not user-visible, but the API contract is a footgun. Recommend merging fields with $set on individual `branding.*` keys, OR reject partial payloads with 400.

ui_bugs.issue: Price row renders as just '€' with no amount and the time-slot icon row is empty for appt_151aaf879e3f. Looks like the appointment record is missing service_price / duration_min on serialization, or the JSX expects optional fields that are not rendered cleanly when null. Not theme-related but visually broken on the dark page.

Non-working Sunday column renders a solid WHITE background while the rest of the grid is dark — the white block is jarring against the onyx theme. Either tint the disabled day in dark grey or hatch it.

issues: body background-color computed as rgb(255,255,255) (white) — the dark canvas is applied to a child wrapper, not <body>. Visually fine because the wrapper covers the viewport, but if the page ever scrolls past the wrapper height it will reveal a white strip. Recommend setting body bg via [data-theme='onyx_gold'] body { background: #0A0A0A; } in theme-onyx-gold.css.

action_items: (MINOR) Harden PUT /api/tenants/me/branding: merge per-field instead of replacing the whole branding doc, OR validate via a Pydantic model that requires all known keys.
(MINOR) Fix ManageBookingPage to hide the price/duration rows when service_price / service_duration are missing, OR include those fields in the GET /api/public/booking/manage/{code} response.
(POLISH) Set body { background: #0A0A0A } under [data-theme='onyx_gold'] so any over-scroll area still reads black.
(POLISH) Tint disabled-day columns (Sun) in onyx_gold theme so the WeekGrid does not render a white column on the dark canvas.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1137 - $set replaces entire `branding` doc. If frontend ever sends a partial PUT, primary_color/business_name will be lost. Same pattern was OK before but theme_preset adds a new field that increases risk of partial updates — recommend tightening.
server.py:2858 - manage-booking endpoint correctly defaults to 'default' when tenant has no branding/preset — good null-safety.
server.py:2982 - client/bookings serialization adds business_theme_preset per appt with default fallback — good.

Frontend: data-theme='onyx_gold' is applied at the wrapper level, scoping CSS overrides cleanly. Cinzel + Allura fonts loaded from Google Fonts and used via font-family chain. Gold leaf SVG decoration renders above the hero on PublicBookingPage as designed.

Frontend: theme preset selector cards in SettingsPage.jsx have data-testid='theme-preset-default' and 'theme-preset-onyx_gold' — testable. Switching auto-fills the colour pickers correctly (verified: onyx swatches #D4AF37/#0A0A0A/#E9D29A → champagne #C4898E/#2C2A29/#D4A373).

success_rate.backend: 100% (4/4 new theme tests pass; 13/13 regression tests across settings + availability also pass)
success_rate.frontend: 95% (Public Booking, Admin Dashboard, Settings/Branding tab with two preset cards + auto-fill, Manage Booking page, Calendar all render correctly under onyx_gold; minor cosmetic items: ManageBookingPage missing price/duration data, Sunday column white in WeekGrid)
